name: F2_vector_of_a_refreshing_group_as_key
description: Task 12.1, F2. Vector columns of a refreshing group_by result as group-by columns of agg_by, as select_distinct columns, as update_by buckets, and in the distinct aggregation. A vector of the reference is a view of its group, so when the step adds a row to the group of K 1 the key or value its operators hold has changed under them: they fail in the cycle (IllegalStateException: Missing value in probe; AggregationOperatorException: Failed to modify or remove data) or keep a stale value. Oxhaven's vectors are values and its results follow the groups.
